detail: Arminius ambushes and destroys three legions under Publius Quinctilius Varus. Rome gives up conquering Germany and the Rhine becomes the frontier; Augustus is said to have cried, "Varus, give me back my legions!"
label: 9 CE
note: Added for context; not from the reading notes.
title: Disaster in the Teutoburg Forest
tldr: Germans under Arminius destroy three legions, and Rome stops at the Rhine.
